meta.source: Reserve Bank of India (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Policy rates and auction results are final when announced. The Handbook restates a few effective dates between editions (newest edition wins, differences listed in rates-policy meta). Lending and deposit rates: each monthly release repeats the full history; the newest release wins.
meta.coverage: Government market borrowing so far in the financial year, week by week since January 2012 (centre and states, gross and net)
meta.note: RBI, Weekly Statistical Supplement, Market Borrowings by the Government of India and State Governments (DBIE report 3; also 314, 317, 727). Running totals from 1 April; they reset each financial year. Converted from rupees to ₹ crore.
